system.description:
You ignite your weapon or unarmed strike with flames performing a flurry of strike, finishing with a heavy strike meant to shatter the ground.

Make two melee Taijutsu attacks comparing the result to the AC of all creatures of your choice that you can see within your attacks range, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage]) + 1d6 fire damage.

Finisher: Each strike is followed by a flaming streak that you can trace to deliver a devastating blow. If an affected creature spends their action on their turn make an attack or cast a jutsu while within your melee attack range, you can make an attack of opportunity against them without spending your reaction, once each. This attacks damage is increased by +1d6 fire damage and then you can move up to your movement speed without provoking opportunity attacks into a space that can hold you.

Chain 3: If you score a hit with at least one attack, the affected creature must make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, your choice, being knocked prone and having their speed reduced by half until the end of their next turn.

Off-Guard. When you deal damage to an Off-Guard creature you gain an additional action which you can use to recast this jutsu. If you do, you gain a +1 bonus to that castings attacks critical threat range against the Off-Guard creature.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d6.
